content.title: About
content.content: Soup NFS (product code 3905) is a ready‑to‑eat dry soup developed by NFS. It consists of dehydrated vegetables, spices and flavor enhancers that form a tasty, nutritious meal when rehydrated with hot water.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Soup NFS is available in more than 20 flavors, ranging from classic chicken to spicy Asian blends.
Each serving provides about 200 kcal, making it a convenient quick‑meal option.
The product is gluten‑free and suitable for people with gluten intolerance.
The rapid‑drying process preserves a high level of vitamins in the ingredients.
Packaging is made from recyclable material to reduce environmental impact.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: The soup contains vitamin B6 and niacin, which support metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Source of plant protein
items.content: Legumes and grains provide about 8 g of protein per serving.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Dehydrated vegetables add fiber that aids normal digestion.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The soup contains virtually no saturated fat, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Electrolytes
items.content: Potassium and sodium are present to help maintain fluid balance.

items.title: Allergy to ingredients
items.content: The soup may contain soy protein, dairy powders or nut‑derived flavorings—check labels if you have allergies.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Some flavors have elevated salt levels; people with hypertension should monitor portion size.

items.title: Requires hot water
items.content: Proper preparation needs water at least 90 °C.

items.title: Possible gluten in certain flavors
items.content: While most variants are gluten‑free, a few may contain wheat in spice mixes.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pour 250 ml of boiling water over the soup, cover, and let it stand for 3–5 minutes. Optionally add fresh vegetables, herbs, or cooked meat pieces.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the package tightly sealed to prevent moisture absorption.
